description: This file provides utility functions to determine the number of retries for specific exceptions based on retry policies, especially in the context of handling errors in a router or API client. It includes functions to extract retry counts from policies and to reset retry policies to default values.

methods.description: Determines the number of retries for a given exception based on the provided retry policy, with support for model-specific policies and exceptions.
